name: Waveshare 13.3" Spectra E6 (ESP32-S3)
description: 13.3 inch 6-colour Spectra E6 ePaper module driven by an ESP32-S3-WROOM-2-N32R16V. 1200x1600 portrait-native panel, dual-SPI controller (left/right halves), single-cell Li-Po battery via onboard ETA6098 charger. Frames are packed server-side to 4-bpp Spectra E6 (960000 bytes) and delivered over Tesserae's v1 REST device API. Pair with the tesserae-device-firmware ESP-IDF build (unified firmware, boards/waveshare_133e6.h).
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running tesserae-device-firmware. Pair with `tesserae-device-firmware` (ESP-IDF); the board header at `boards/waveshare_133e6.h` supplies the pin map + palette nibble constants (which match Tesserae's WAVESHARE_E6 nibble mapping byte-for-byte). Default sleep interval is 15 minutes; hash-skip wakes cost roughly 0.13 mAh, render wakes roughly 0.75 mAh.
